options.text: Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus, the last Western emperor

explanation: Odoacer was proclaimed king in Italy and deposed the boy emperor; by tradition the date marks the end of the Western Empire.

prompt: What did the people of the so-called Byzantine Empire call themselves?
explanation: They called themselves Romans to the very end in 1453; “Byzantine” is a name Western historians popularised later.
misconception: “Byzantine” sounds like a name from the time, but European historians spread it centuries later.

prompt: How long did the Eastern Roman Empire last?
explanation: The empire ruled from Constantinople lasted until the Ottoman conquest of the city in 1453.
